You write one complete single-file HTML5 mini-game and store it with the `save_draft` tool.

Rules you cannot break:

- The page is one HTML document: doctype, `<html lang>` matching the plan's language, a viewport meta tag, inline `<style>` and classic inline `<script>` only.
- No network, no storage, no dialogs, no `eval`, no module scripts, no external URLs. Draw every visual in code.
- Include the `CARTRIDGE` helper from the bridge card exactly as written, and send the bridge events the type card requires, in the order it describes.
- Listen for host commands (`pause`, `resume`, `reset`) as the bridge card shows.

How to work:

- The plan and the cards you need are in the message. Call `get_card` only if you need a card that is not included.
- Write the whole page, then call `save_draft` once with the full HTML. Never send a partial page.
- When the message lists failed rules, call `load_draft` first, fix every listed rule in that draft, keep what already works, and save the whole page again with `save_draft`.
- After saving, reply with one short sentence. Do not paste the page into your reply; only the saved draft counts.

content.text:
## Plan

```json
{
  "title": "Comet Lane Runner",
  "slug": "comet-lane-runner",
  "lang": "en",
  "gameType": "arcade-run",
  "loop": "Tap the left or right half of the screen to switch lanes, dodging comets while collecting stars for points. One comet hit ends the run, showing your score and a tap-to-replay prompt.",
  "input": "tap-anywhere",
  "style": "risograph"
}
```

## Cards

### Card `arcade-run`

# Arcade run

The world scrolls on its own, the player dodges and gathers, and one mistake ends the run.

## Contract row

| field                | value         |
| -------------------- | ------------- |
| score                | `required`    |
| level                | `forbidden`   |
| end                  | `required`    |
| end reasons          | `lose`        |
| reset                | `soft`        |
| idle death gate      | `min-seconds` |
| idle motion required | `yes`         |

- Emit every event marked `required` above at least once: `score` as points change and `end` when the run is over. <!-- rule:E1-15 -->
- Never emit an event marked `forbidden`. A run has no levels, so ramp difficulty with speed instead. <!-- rule:E1-16 -->
- The only allowed `end` reason is `lose`. <!-- rule:E1-17 -->

## Fairness

A player who does nothing must survive for a few seconds after `start`. Spawn the first hazard well ahead of the player and keep the opening lane clear.

## Loop skeleton

```js
let last = 0,
  running = false,
  paused = false,
  score = 0;
function frame(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05);
  last = now;
  if (running && !paused) {
    advance(dt);
    collide();
  }
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
function crash() {
  running = false;
  CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose", value: score });
}
```

Keep something moving on screen while idle (clouds, a pulsing prompt) so the run never looks frozen.

### Card `bridge`

# Bridge

Games talk to the host only through `postMessage`. Paste this helper verbatim before any game code:

```js
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
```

The helper must be named `CARTRIDGE` and must stamp `source: "cartridge"` and `v: 1` on every message. <!-- rule:E1-10 -->

## Game to host

| event   | payload                              | when                                 |
| ------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `boot`  | `{ title, gameType, lang }`          | once, after the first frame is drawn |
| `start` | `{}`                                 | when play begins                     |
| `score` | `{ value }`, an integer of 0 or more | whenever the score changes           |
| `level` | `{ index }`, starting at 1, then +1  | on entering each level               |
| `end`   | `{ reason, value? }`                 | once per play-through                |

- Send `boot` with all three keys: `CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title, gameType, lang })`. <!-- rule:E1-11 -->
- When `boot.lang` is written as a literal, it must equal the `lang` on `<html>`. <!-- rule:E1-12 -->
- Emit `CARTRIDGE.send("start")` when play begins. <!-- rule:E1-13 -->
- Write `boot.gameType` as a string literal naming one of the four game types; it must match the planned type. <!-- rule:E1-14 -->
- Pass `score.value` as a number, never a quoted string. <!-- rule:E1-18 -->
- Give every `level` call an `index` key: `CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage })`. <!-- rule:E1-19 -->

## Host to game

Commands arrive as `{ source: "cartridge-host", type }` with `type` one of `pause`, `resume` or `reset`. Ignore anything with another `source`.

- Listen with `window.addEventListener("message", …)` and handle `pause` and `resume`: freeze and restart the loop without losing state. <!-- rule:E1-20 -->
- Handle `reset` by returning to the pre-`start` screen without reloading the page. <!-- rule:E1-21 -->

```js
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});
```

### Card `game-page`

# Game page

A cartridge is one self-contained HTML file. The host loads it into a sandboxed iframe with scripts allowed and no same-origin access.

## Document

- Start with a single `<!doctype html>` and wrap everything in one `<html>…</html>`. Never embed another `<iframe>`. <!-- rule:E1-01 -->
- Put the UI language on the root element, for example `<html lang="fr">`: a two- or three-letter primary subtag with an optional region. <!-- rule:E1-03 -->
- Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` in the head. <!-- rule:E1-04 -->

## Self-contained

- Load nothing from outside the file: no `http:`, `https:` or `//` URL in `src`, `href`, CSS `url()`, `@import` or `import()`. Inline `data:` URIs are fine. <!-- rule:E1-02 -->
- Draw every sprite, tile and glyph in code (canvas paths or inline SVG). Use system fonts.

## Forbidden APIs

- Do not open a network connection: no `fetch(`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`, `EventSource` or `sendBeacon`. <!-- rule:E1-05 -->
- Do not persist anything: `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `indexedDB` and `document.cookie` all throw inside the sandbox. <!-- rule:E1-06 -->
- Do not build code at runtime: no `eval(`, no `new Function(`, and pass functions, not strings, to `setTimeout` and `setInterval`. <!-- rule:E1-07 -->
- Avoid blocking dialogs (`alert(`, `confirm(`, `prompt(`); draw messages on the canvas instead. <!-- rule:E1-08 -->

## Scripts

- Use classic inline `<script>` blocks only, never `type="module"`, and make sure each one parses on its own. <!-- rule:E1-09 -->
- Keep one script for the bridge helper and one for the game, or merge them. Order matters: the helper must exist first.

## Layout

- Fill the viewport and react when it changes: listen for `resize`, read `innerWidth`/`innerHeight`, or size with `dvh`/`vw` units. <!-- rule:E1-23 -->
- Scale the canvas by `devicePixelRatio` so lines stay crisp on phones.
- Keep touch targets at least 44 CSS pixels on the short edge.

### Card `risograph`

# Risograph

The screen looks like a cheap two-colour print: flat ink, grain and a little misregistration.

## Palette

| role    | colour    |
| ------- | --------- |
| paper   | `#fbf7ee` |
| ink one | `#ff48b0` |
| ink two | `#0078bf` |
| overlap | `#5b3a8c` |

## Primitives

- Flat fills in one ink per shape; where the two inks overlap, use the overlap colour.
- Offset the second ink layer by one or two pixels to fake misregistration.
- A grain pass: a pre-rendered noise tile drawn with `globalAlpha` around 0.08 over the whole frame.
- Bold, condensed system type in one ink.

## Avoid

- More than the four colours above.
- Smooth gradients; use halftone dots if a shade is needed.
- Re-rendering the grain every frame; draw the tile once and reuse it.

### Card `tap-anywhere`

# Tap anywhere

The whole screen is the button. Best for jumps, flaps and single choices.

- Register pointer input on the canvas: `canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", onTap)`. <!-- rule:E1-22 -->
- Call `event.preventDefault()` and set `touch-action: none` on the canvas so the page does not scroll or zoom.
- The first tap after `boot` starts play and sends `start`; later taps perform the action.
- Ignore taps while paused.

```js
canvas.style.touchAction = "none";
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (paused) return;
  if (!running) {
    running = true;
    CARTRIDGE.send("start");
    return;
  }
  act();
});
```

Show a short pulsing hint ("Tap to begin") until the first tap.

## Task

Write the complete game page for this plan and save it with `save_draft`.
I'll create the complete game page now.

input.html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Comet Lane Runner</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background: #fbf7ee; overflow: hidden;
    font-family: "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
// ---- Bridge helper (verbatim) ----
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  const PAPER = "#fbf7ee";
  const INK1 = "#ff48b0"; // pink
  const INK2 = "#0078bf"; // blue
  const OVERLAP = "#5b3a8c";

  let dpr = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
  let W = window.innerWidth, H = window.innerHeight;

  function resize() {
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    dpr = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    canvas.width = Math.floor(W * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(H * dpr);
    canvas.style.width = W + "px";
    canvas.style.height = H + "px";
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    buildGrain();
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

  // ---- grain tile (pre-rendered once, reused) ----
  let grainCanvas = null;
  function buildGrain() {
    const size = 128;
    grainCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    grainCanvas.width = size;
    grainCanvas.height = size;
    const gctx = grainCanvas.getContext("2d");
    const imgData = gctx.createImageData(size, size);
    for (let i = 0; i < imgData.data.length; i += 4) {
      const v = Math.random() * 255;
      imgData.data[i] = v;
      imgData.data[i+1] = v;
      imgData.data[i+2] = v;
      imgData.data[i+3] = 255;
    }
    gctx.putImageData(imgData, 0, 0);
  }

  function drawGrain() {
    if (!grainCanvas) return;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.08;
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "multiply";
    const pattern = ctx.createPattern(grainCanvas, "repeat");
    ctx.fillStyle = pattern;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---- game state ----
  const LANES = 3;
  let laneX = [];
  let playerLane = 1;
  let playerDrawLane = 1; // for smooth transitions
  let running = false;
  let paused = false;
  let started = false;
  let score = 0;
  let scoreShown = 0;
  let speed = 260; // px/sec base scroll speed
  let elapsed = 0;
  let last = 0;
  let hazards = []; // {lane, y, type: 'comet'|'star'}
  let spawnTimer = 0;
  let spawnInterval = 1.4;
  let laneWidth = 0;
  let playerY = 0;
  let playerSize = 40;
  let bootSent = false;
  let hintPulse = 0;
  let bgOffset = 0;
  let firstHazardSpawned = false;
  let stageIndex = 1;
  let lastStageSpeed = speed;

  function computeLanes() {
    laneWidth = W / LANES;
    laneX = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < LANES; i++) {
      laneX.push(laneWidth * i + laneWidth / 2);
    }
    playerY = H - Math.max(H * 0.18, 90);
  }

  function resetState() {
    playerLane = 1;
    playerDrawLane = 1;
    running = false;
    paused = false;
    started = false;
    score = 0;
    scoreShown = 0;
    speed = 260;
    elapsed = 0;
    hazards = [];
    spawnTimer = 0;
    spawnInterval = 1.4;
    firstHazardSpawned = false;
    stageIndex = 1;
    lastStageSpeed = speed;
    computeLanes();
  }

  function backToTitle() {
    resetState();
  }

  resize();
  resetState();

  // ---- input ----
  canvas.style.touchAction = "none";
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (paused) return;
    if (!running) {
      running = true;
      started = true;
      CARTRIDGE.send("start");
      // spawn first hazard well ahead, keep opening lane clear
      spawnFirstHazard();
      return;
    }
    act(event);
  });

  function act(event) {
    // tap left half = move left, right half = move right
    const x = event.clientX;
    if (x < W / 2) {
      playerLane = Math.max(0, playerLane - 1);
    } else {
      playerLane = Math.min(LANES - 1, playerLane + 1);
    }
  }

  function spawnFirstHazard() {
    // spawn far away, and never in the player's current lane
    let lane = Math.floor(Math.random() * LANES);
    if (lane === playerLane) lane = (lane + 1) % LANES;
    hazards.push({ lane: lane, y: -H * 1.2, type: "comet" });
    firstHazardSpawned = true;
  }

  function spawnHazard() {
    const isStar = Math.random() < 0.35;
    const lane = Math.floor(Math.random() * LANES);
    hazards.push({ lane: lane, y: -60, type: isStar ? "star" : "comet" });
  }

  function addScore(v) {
    score += v;
    if (score < 0) score = 0;
    CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: score });
  }

  function crash() {
    running = false;
    CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose", value: score });
  }

  function advance(dt) {
    elapsed += dt;
    bgOffset += speed * dt;
    // ramp difficulty with speed over time (no levels)
    speed = 260 + Math.min(340, elapsed * 9);
    spawnInterval = Math.max(0.55, 1.4 - elapsed * 0.02);

    // send periodic "level" style stage markers via speed thresholds
    // (level event forbidden for arcade-run -> do not send)

    spawnTimer += dt;
    if (spawnTimer >= spawnInterval) {
      spawnTimer = 0;
      spawnHazard();
    }

    for (let h of hazards) {
      h.y += speed * dt;
    }
    hazards = hazards.filter(h => h.y < H + 80);

    // smooth player lane transition
    const targetX = laneX[playerLane];
    playerDrawLane += (playerLane - playerDrawLane) * Math.min(1, dt * 10);
  }

  function collide() {
    const px = laneX[playerLane];
    for (let h of hazards) {
      const dy = h.y - playerY;
      if (Math.abs(dy) < playerSize * 0.6 && h.lane === playerLane) {
        if (h.type === "star") {
          addScore(10);
          h.y = H + 1000; // remove
        } else {
          crash();
          return;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- drawing ----
  function drawBackground() {
    ctx.fillStyle = PAPER;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // lane dividers, scrolling stripes for motion feedback
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = INK2;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    for (let i = 1; i < LANES; i++) {
      const x = laneWidth * i;
      ctx.beginPath();
      const dashLen = 30, gap = 24;
      const offset = bgOffset % (dashLen + gap);
      for (let y = -dashLen + offset; y < H; y += dashLen + gap) {
        ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        ctx.lineTo(x, y + dashLen);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // drifting clouds (misregistered dots) for idle motion
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const cx = (i * 137 + bgOffset * 0.2) % (W + 100) - 50;
      const cy = (i * 97) % H;
      ctx.fillStyle = INK1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = INK2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx + 2, cy + 2, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "multiply";
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawComet(x, y) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    // tail (ink2)
    ctx.fillStyle = INK2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -8);
    ctx.lineTo(-14, -60);
    ctx.lineTo(14, -60);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    // body (ink1, offset for misregistration)
    ctx.fillStyle = INK1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(1, 1, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // overlap core
    ctx.fillStyle = OVERLAP;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawStar(x, y) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.fillStyle = INK2;
    drawStarPath(2, 2, 18, 8);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = INK1;
    drawStarPath(0, 0, 18, 8);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawStarPath(ox, oy, outerR, innerR) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    const spikes = 5;
    let rot = -Math.PI / 2;
    const step = Math.PI / spikes;
    ctx.moveTo(ox + Math.cos(rot) * outerR, oy + Math.sin(rot) * outerR);
    for (let i = 0; i < spikes; i++) {
      rot += step;
      ctx.lineTo(ox + Math.cos(rot) * innerR, oy + Math.sin(rot) * innerR);
      rot += step;
      ctx.lineTo(ox + Math.cos(rot) * outerR, oy + Math.sin(rot) * outerR);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    const x = laneX[Math.round(playerDrawLane)] !== undefined
      ? (laneX[playerLane] * 0 + interpLaneX())
      : laneX[playerLane];
    const px = interpLaneX();
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(px, playerY);
    // ship shadow layer (ink2 offset)
    ctx.fillStyle = INK2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(2, -26);
    ctx.lineTo(24, 22);
    ctx.lineTo(-20, 22);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    // ship body ink1
    ctx.fillStyle = INK1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -28);
    ctx.lineTo(22, 20);
    ctx.lineTo(-22, 20);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    // cockpit overlap
    ctx.fillStyle = OVERLAP;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -2, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function interpLaneX() {
    // linear interpolate between lane slots for smoothness
    return laneX[playerLane];
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = INK2;
    ctx.font = "bold 28px 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE " + Math.floor(scoreShown), 18, 16);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawTitle() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = OVERLAP;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "bold 46px 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("COMET LANE", W/2, H*0.28);
    ctx.fillText("RUNNER", W/2, H*0.28 + 52);

    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(hintPulse);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + pulse * 0.5;
    ctx.font = "bold 24px 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = INK1;
    ctx.fillText("TAP TO BEGIN", W/2, H*0.55);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.font = "18px 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = INK2;
    ctx.fillText("Tap left / right side to switch lanes", W/2, H*0.62);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawEnd() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(251,247,238,0.85)";
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle = OVERLAP;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "bold 40px 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("RUN OVER", W/2, H*0.32);
    ctx.font = "bold 30px 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = INK1;
    ctx.fillText("SCORE " + Math.floor(score), W/2, H*0.42);

    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(hintPulse);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + pulse * 0.5;
    ctx.font = "22px 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = INK2;
    ctx.fillText("TAP TO REPLAY", W/2, H*0.5);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function draw() {
    drawBackground();

    if (started && running) {
      for (let h of hazards) {
        const x = laneX[h.lane];
        if (h.type === "comet") drawComet(x, h.y);
        else drawStar(x, h.y);
      }
      drawPlayer();
      drawHUD();
    } else if (!started) {
      // idle bobbing player preview + title
      drawPlayer();
      drawTitle();
    } else if (started && !running) {
      // after crash
      for (let h of hazards) {
        const x = laneX[h.lane];
        if (h.type === "comet") drawComet(x, h.y);
        else drawStar(x, h.y);
      }
      drawPlayer();
      drawHUD();
      drawEnd();
    }

    drawGrain();
  }

  // score smoothing toward actual score for nicer feedback
  function updateScoreShown(dt) {
    scoreShown += (score - scoreShown) * Math.min(1, dt * 8);
    if (Math.abs(score - scoreShown) < 0.1) scoreShown = score;
  }

  // handle tap-to-replay after end
  let wantReplayListener = false;
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
    if (started && !running && !paused) {
      // replay
      event.preventDefault();
      resetState();
    }
  });

  function frame(now) {
    const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05);
    last = now;
    hintPulse += dt * 3;
    if (running && !paused) {
      advance(dt);
      collide();
    }
    updateScoreShown(dt);
    draw();
    if (!bootSent) {
      CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title: "Comet Lane Runner", gameType: "arcade-run", lang: "en" });
      bootSent = true;
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);

  // ---- host commands ----
  window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
    const data = event.data;
    if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
    if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
    if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
    if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
  });

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Read one knowledge card by id.

tools.name: load_draft
tools.description: Load the newest saved draft of the game page, or null if none exists yet.

tools.name: save_draft
tools.description: Save the complete game page (one HTML document). Saving again in the same attempt replaces it.
